why: A moved more real traffic and verified it harder (29-site inventory, 55/55 live requests across labelled features, plus Router added as a user-selectable provider — the only activation path that actually works in a keyless browser extension, where B's build-time env bridge only ever routes an operator's internal build), and its system-level review is far deeper: the page/document context sitting in the last human message defeating prompt caching is the correct headline finding for this app, correctly derived from the code and correctly ranked as a product-sign-off rework rather than a quiet commit. B is honest and tidy but shipped one improvement, under-inventoried the call sites, and its proposed Router-as-provider route goes through the Anthropic Messages client for the whole catalog — an unverified and architecturally odd choice next to A's already-live /v1/responses translation.
A_best: Identifying that the retrieved page/document context is substituted into the last human message in four modes, so a 10k-token page is re-charged at full price every follow-up, with the already-correct web-search mode cited as the reference shape and the cache measurements (-90% Claude, -49% gpt-4o-mini) attached — the largest cost and TTFT lever in the product, found by reading the prompts, not the gateway docs.
B_best: Spotting that the app sets no timeout anywhere on the chat path and closing it with provider_timeout as a policy-only change, with the correct distinction that on a stream it bounds inter-event idle time rather than answer length — real Router-only leverage for a product whose failure mode today is an infinite spinner.
A_worst: The cross-vendor candidate list for background titles quietly answers with a model the user did not pick, and leaving streamed chat on the account Flex default while pinning only the rewrites is the weaker half of the tier split given the measured 61 s Flex tail; several improvements (i3, i4) are reasoned from control flow with no behavioural sample.
B_worst: Calling src/libs/openai.ts:43 "the Anthropic model list" and then building the proposed Router provider on CustomChatAnthropic's Messages client — asserting Router serves /v1/messages for every catalog model while its own evidence says non-Claude models were never exercised — when the migration already has a working chat/completions-to-/v1/responses translation that reaches the whole catalog.
